subject: Re: Partner governance & ticketing integration for GRC evidence workflows
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@grace-consulting.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Partner intake: automated evidence ticketing + governance integration

Hi Markus —

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. Grace Consulting works with a number of ISVs to automate the flow of SOC 2 / PEN evidence into ticketing systems for customers and partners. We think there is a good fit for an integration that would allow Redwood customers to: 

- Trigger evidence collection requests from Redwood Console to a partner ticketing queue
- Exchange redacted audit artifacts (logs, config snapshots) via secured, auditable channels
- Surface status and ETA back in the Console so customers can see where evidence requests are in the queue

We put together a short intake checklist attached to help scope (stuff like retention windows, minimum auth, evidence TTL). Can you confirm who on your side owns partner onboarding (commercial + legal) and who will own the technical integration?

A few technical questions up front:
- Is there a preferred auth pattern for partner-to-Redwood evidence uploads (API key, mutual TLS, or OIDC client)?
- Are there constraints we should know about for storing 3rd-party evidence objects (S3 buckets / encryption / redaction requirements)?
- Do you have a standard SLA or timeline for partner onboarding?

If this looks promising we can set a 30-min scoping call next week and bring our engineering lead.

Attachments: [Attachment: onboarding_checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Partnerships Lead — Grace Consulting
elena.ruiz@grace-consulting.com
+1 (415) 555-0199
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@grace-consulting.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Partner intake: automated evidence ticketing + governance integration

Elena —

Thanks, this is helpful and the checklist is a good starting point. Internal owners:
- Commercial / partner contract: Marissa Cole (cc'd)
- Partner engineering / integration: Sergio Alvarez (cc'd)

Quick answers to your questions:
- Auth: we prefer short-lived OIDC client tokens for push uploads, but mutual TLS is acceptable for high-security exchanges. We'll need per-partner service accounts and token rotation.
- Storage: evidence artifacts typically land in customer-scoped S3 with SSE-KMS. We enforce automated redaction rules for PII before long-term retention.
- SLA: standard partner onboarding target is 6–8 weeks from scoping to production, but we can accelerate for strategic partners.

Marissa / Sergio — please review the checklist and propose next steps. If Grace is comfortable with auth + storage model, I'd like to slot a joint scoping call the week of Nov 29. Elena, are you available Nov 30 10am ET?

Regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: Grace partnership intake — immediate asks and owners

Marissa / Sergio —

Following up after Elena's intake. Summary and requested owners: 

- Commercial (Marissa): review the checklist for any commercial/contract items, confirm if we can offer a 90-day trial waiver on integration fees for strategic customers, and pull any precedent SOW language we can reuse.
- Technical (Sergio): review API auth options and estimate engineering effort for connector (we should treat this like a lightweight webhook + secured upload flow). Please outline required Redwood Console UI hooks (status updates, ticket ID mapping).

Proposed timeline (target):
1) Nov 29–Dec 3: scoping call + draft API spec
2) Dec 6–17: engineering spike / PoC
3) Jan 10: partner-go-live (pilot with 1 customer)

I created a tracking ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PARTN-423 — please add time estimates and any blockers.

Thanks — keep the replies short here so we can forward a concise plan to Elena.

Subject: Draft API pattern + scoping options for evidence exchange

Hi Markus / Sergio —

Following Elena's intro, Aegis took a pass at a minimal API contract that maps to the checklist. Key points: 
- Auth: OIDC client credentials recommended; we include an example token exchange flow in the doc.
- Uploads: multipart POST to /partners/{partner_id}/evidence with metadata envelope (artifact type, retention TTL, source UUID).
- Webhooks: optional webhook for ticket status changes back to Redwood Console.

I've attached the API spec draft (API_spec.md) and a short note on redaction expectations. Proposed scoping call windows: Dec 7–9 (we can do 30–45m).

Attachments: [Attachment: API_spec.md (text/markdown)]

Best,
